# The Cabal of the Inverted Star — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **CAST** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — The Inverted Rite (spells):** Each Sorcerer (a Leader with a [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] weapon) may cast 1 spell per activation without spending an Action; each spell once per round for the army. Roll 2D6 (safe) or 3D6 (channel: the effect is doubled where marked ×2; if 2+ dice show a 1, the Sorcerer suffers D3 Fatal Wounds). Spells: Hex-Bolt (6+) D3 Fatal Wounds to an enemy unit within 18″ ×2 · Veil of Mirrors (6+) a friendly unit within 12″ is −1 to be Hit until the End of Round · Warp-Breach (7+) a friendly unit's weapons get +1 PEN this round · Withering Gaze (7+) an enemy unit within 18″ gets −1 to Hit until the End of Round · Chrono-Step (8+) a friendly unit within 12″ makes a 3″ move ×2 · Inverted Geometry (9+) swap two friendly unengaged units within 18″ of the Sorcerer (counts as their move).

**Gamble — Channel the Star** *(risk: durability (dice))*: Built into every cast: roll 3D6 instead of 2D6 — marked effects are doubled; if two or more dice show a 1, the Sorcerer suffers D3 Fatal Wounds.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Veil & Breach* — Spell support spread over the army.

## Detachment — Grand Coven

*Three or four sorcerers, a wall of automata, spells every activation.*

**Detachment rule:** Coven: Sorcerers within 6″ of another friendly Sorcerer get +1 to casting rolls; Hex-Bolt can be cast twice per round.

**Enhancements**
- **Grimoire of the Inverted Star** (+10 pts, Master of the Astral Geometry): Knows one extra spell: Unmaking (9+): an enemy unit within 18″ loses WARD until the End of Round.
- **Familiar** (+10 pts, Sorcerer-Adept): Re-roll one casting die per round.

**Stratagems**
- **Arcane Surge** (1 CP) — *A spell is cast:* +2 to the casting roll.
- **Dispel** (1 CP) — *An enemy [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] effect targets a unit within 12″ of a Sorcerer:* Roll 2D6: on 7+ it is cancelled.
- **Siphon the Warp** (1 CP) — *A Sorcerer suffers backlash:* Ignore it.

## Detachment — Automaton Legion

*Hollow automata advance under arcane fire.*

**Detachment rule:** All Is Ash: Hollow and Hex-Plated Automata have WARD 5+; their ranged weapons gain [SHREDDING WOUNDS] while within 6″ of a Sorcerer.

**Enhancements**
- **Soul-Binding** (+15 pts, Hex-Blade Exalted): The attached unit has UNYIELDING 6+.
- **Inferno Rounds** (+10 pts, Hollow Automata): +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

**Stratagems**
- **Warp-Flame Volley** (1 CP) — *An Automata unit Shoots:* Weapons gain [IGNORES COVER].
- **March of the Dead Souls** (1 CP) — *An Automata unit activates:* It may Move and Shoot without the [HEAVY] penalty.
- **Dust Reforms** (2 CP) — *Command Phase:* Return D3 slain models to an Automata unit within 6″ of a Sorcerer.

## Detachment — Geometry Weavers

*Board control: swap, step and confuse.*

**Detachment rule:** Inverted Geometry costs 1 CP instead of a cast (still once per round). Units that were swapped get [STEALTH] until the End of Round.

**Enhancements**
- **Tesseract Key** (+10 pts, Seer of the Inverted Star): Inverted Geometry range is 24″.
- **Mirror-Shard Robe** (+15 pts, Master of the Astral Geometry): The attached unit is [STEALTH].

**Stratagems**
- **Fold Space** (1 CP) — *A unit is targeted by a Charge:* It makes a 3″ move before the roll.
- **Doubled Geometry** (2 CP) — *Inverted Geometry is cast:* Cast it a second time this round.
- **Lost in the Maze** (1 CP) — *An enemy unit within 12″ of a Sorcerer activates:* −2″ to its moves this activation.
